notes: Phase 5 verify — findings fixed inline: (Major) the redirection trigger refused `2>/dev/null` and `2>&1`, a false positive on the most common read-only redirection and on the shipped ADLC preamble shape; both are now exempt and both directions are mutation-checked. (Major) a `a || b` preamble was given two full per-command timeouts, reopening BUG-185's bound; the two steps now share one deadline. (Major) the two new skill events were produced but never asserted on the bus (LESSON-544's shape); `the_root_gate_records_reach_the_bus` closes it.

Phase 5 deferred, argued structurally rather than tested: AC-4's `cost.db records no model call` — the gate returns before `acknowledge_project` and `expand_and_fold`, and `the_refusal_runs_no_preamble_command` proves no command ran, but no test reads cost.db. AC-6's piped leg (`printf 'cd x\n' | teton` reaches the model) — the hint is one `if ctx.typed_input` at the single call site; driving main.rs's entry loop from a test would be a new harness. AC-1's live three-of-three trial on the shipped local model is manual and was NOT run in this pipeline.

Phase 8: single-repo topology, so this runner owned the merge. Trial-merge against a freshly fetched origin/main returned rc=0; all eight CI jobs green on the final tip; merged from the parent repo path because git refuses to delete a branch a worktree owns. Terminal claim: merged.
